summary_1line: Sugriva dispatches Vinata and vast monkey forces eastward, detailing rivers, lands, mythical beings, and cosmic landmarks to search for Sita and Ravana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva stands beside Rama and Lakshmana while countless monkeys surround them like storm clouds, roaring and bowing before their king.
Monkeys journey past a colossal red ocean where gigantic demons hang from cliffs and fall into the waters at sunrise.
On a golden mountain peak, the thousand‑headed serpent Ananta lies coiled beside a shining palm tree marking the boundary of the eastern world.
